description: Resource schema for an EC2 Import Image Task. This is a read-only resource representing a VM image import job.

Arn.description: The ARN of the import image task.

ImportTaskId.description: The ID of the import image task.

ImageId.description: The ID of the AMI of the imported virtual machine. Populated only once the import task completes; an in-progress task returns an empty string.

Status.description: A brief status for the import image task.

SnapshotDetails.description: Information about the snapshots created from the imported disks.

Description.description: A description string for the import image task.

Encrypted.description: Specifies whether the destination AMI of the imported image should be encrypted.

KmsKeyId.description: An identifier for the symmetric AWS KMS key used to create the encrypted AMI.

LicenseType.description: The license type to be used for the Amazon Machine Image (AMI) after importing.

LicenseSpecifications.description: The ARNs of the license configurations.

UsageOperation.description: The usage operation value for the AMI.

BootMode.description: The boot mode of the virtual machine. The enum mirrors EC2's shared BootModeValues shape; ImportImage itself does not accept uefi-preferred.

Tags.description: The tags for the import image task.

UserBucket.description: Describes the Amazon S3 bucket for the disk image.

S3Bucket.description: The name of the Amazon S3 bucket where the disk image is located.

S3Key.description: The file name of the disk image.

ImportImageLicenseConfiguration.description: The response information for license configurations.

LicenseConfigurationArn.description: The ARN of a license configuration.

SnapshotDetail.description: Describes the snapshot created from the imported disk.

DiskImageSize.description: The size of the disk in the snapshot, in GiB.

Format.description: The format of the disk image from which the snapshot is created.

SnapshotId.description: The snapshot ID of the disk being imported. Populated once the import task completes.

Status.description: A brief status of the snapshot creation.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.
